" def render_user_profile(username: str, bio: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a user's profile information safely for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user-entered name. bio : str A potentially multi-sentence biography written by the user. status_message : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The formatted profile string with all content HTML-escaped to avoid injection attacks (CWE‑707). Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(username, str): raise TypeError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(bio, str): raise TypeError("bio must be a string") if not isinstance(status_message, str): raise TypeError("status_message must be a string") # Sanitize all user-provided content to neutralize potential HTML/JS injection safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Render the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
